about: Detected draft from the 11-stem split of the set's reference (Royal Blood_Out of the Black [2026-09-15 100512].wav, 324.123 s), placed on the set's tempo map (16th grid). at: bar and beat in the bar (bar 19 is 3/4). beat: song beat from the song locator, sections end to end in 4/4 (the myDMX convention). seconds: that beat in the reference audio through the clip's warp markers (BeatTime = beat - 4). onset_seconds: where the onset was detected in the reference audio. secs: song seconds from bar 1. piece: the kit stem. strength: onset strength against the stem's 99.5th percentile, /1.5. Cymbals are the least reliable stem (the verse 2 ride reads as crashes).

hook_figure.about: The signature figure, two-bar cell: kick 1, snare 3 | kick 2, snare 3, and every other time a kick on the and of 3. Played in Hook (88-95), Band In (96-103), Hook (2) (163-178, with the drummer's variations in 164, 170, 172, 174, 176, 178) and the intro (3-19). Hits (179-186) is a different figure: kick and crash together on 1 and 3.
